title: Clarifying Rate Limits for a team

question.author: member_010
question.body: Before I explain rate limits to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current API Reference documentation says: Burst allowances are not available. Read-only endpoints (listing, metadata) count the same as writes. API requests are limited to 1000 requests per hour per token. When the limit is hit, the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; clients should implement exponential backoff. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
